Dear Varsha Gouripeddi,

A new job opening has officially been uploaded and published on the OKLUT Careers & Recruitment Portal! As part of our active Employee Referral Program, we encourage all team members to refer outstanding professionals from their network or explore internal career advancement.

Employee Referral Code

Department: Corporate
Work Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time
Available Vacancies: 1 Position(s)

Role Overview & Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) Consultant / Engineer to support SAP MDG projects, covering functional and technical aspects of master data management, data governance, system integration, and implementation. The candidate will be responsible for designing and configuring MDG solutions, managing master data domains, supporting data replication and integration, coordinating with customers and partners, and participating in end-to-end testing, data migration, and cutover activities.

Key Qualifications & Skills

• Hands-on experience in SAP MDG implementation, configuration, or support. • Experience with data modelling, process modelling, and UI modelling. • Knowledge of business rules, validation rules, derivations, and workflow configuration. • Experience with Data Replication Framework (DRF) and master data replication. • Knowledge of Customer, Vendor, and Material master data management. • Experience with SOA Web Services and ALE/IDoc integration. • Experience in requirements gathering, testing, data migration, and cutover activities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. • Understanding of master data governance principles and processes. • Ability to work independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
🎁

How to Refer & Earn Your Employee Bonus

Every successful hire through employee referral is eligible for attractive referral rewards disbursed with your monthly payroll.
